panels.title: Topology: clients to the CPE, the CPE to the internet
panels.description: Client nodes show the LAN round trip measured at the CPE (p50 of their TCP handshakes, else their ping) and the WAN part of their connections. They are coloured by LAN p90 once a client opened 5 connections, else by its ping: green under 10 ms, yellow under 30 ms, red above, grey without data. A client behind an extender that runs the probe has its own hop on its edge: the round trip between the extender and the client alone. The extender's edge to the CPE is the backhaul, the extender's ping to the CPE (else the CPE's ping to the extender). Category nodes show the CPE's own TCP probes.

targets.rawSQL: WITH nh AS ( SELECT coalesce(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client'), substr(target_id, 5)) AS client, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_name'), ts_ms) AS host FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind IN ('lan', 'flow') AND json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_name') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ), nm AS ( SELECT client, CASE WHEN count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(host)) > 1 THEN host || ' #' || substr(client, 1, 4) ELSE host END AS label FROM nh WHERE NOT regexp_like(lower(host), '^(\*|localhost|unknown|none|wlan[0-9]*|eth[0-9]*|android[-_]?[0-9a-f]*|esp[-_][0-9a-f]+|espressif|[0-9a-f]{8,}|([0-9a-f]{2}[-:]?){6})$') ) , f AS ( SELECT ts_ms, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client') AS client, coalesce(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.node'), 'cpe') AS node, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.medium') AS medium, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.band') AS band, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.proto') AS proto, status, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.lan_ms') AS double) AS lan, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.wan_ms') AS double) AS wan FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'flow' ), fc AS ( SELECT client, max_by(node, ts_ms) AS node, max_by(medium, ts_ms) AS medium, max_by(band, ts_ms) AS band, count(*) AS flows, count(lan) FILTER (WHERE proto = 'tcp' AND status = 'ok') AS lann, approx_percentile(lan, 0.5) FILTER (WHERE proto = 'tcp' AND status = 'ok') AS lan50, approx_percentile(lan, 0.9) FILTER (WHERE proto = 'tcp' AND status = 'ok') AS lan90, approx_percentile(wan, 0.5) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ok') AS wan50 FROM f GROUP BY 1 ), e AS ( SELECT json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client') AS client, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.node'), ts_ms) AS node, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.medium'), ts_ms) AS medium, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.band'), ts_ms) AS band, count(*) FILTER (WHERE json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.lan_ms') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.proto') = 'tcp' AND status = 'ok') AS hopn, approx_percentile(CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.lan_ms') AS double), 0.5) FILTER (WHERE json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.proto') = 'tcp' AND status = 'ok') AS hop50, approx_percentile(CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.lan_ms') AS double), 0.9) FILTER (WHERE json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.proto') = 'tcp' AND status = 'ok') AS hop90 FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$ext' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'flow' GROUP BY 1 ), ew AS ( SELECT json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client') AS client, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.node'), ts_ms) AS node, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.band'), ts_ms) AS band, avg(CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.rssi') AS double)) AS rssi FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$ext' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'wifi_sta' GROUP BY 1 ), eu AS ( SELECT approx_percentile(rtt_ms, 0.5) AS v FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$ext' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'icmp' AND target_id = 'uplink' AND status = 'ok' ), p AS ( SELECT substr(target_id, 5) AS client, max_by(dst_ip, ts_ms) AS ip, max_by(coalesce(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.node'), 'cpe'), ts_ms) AS node, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.medium'), ts_ms) AS double)), 0) AS retry_pct FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = '#73bf69' WHEN coalesce(CASE WHEN lann >= 5 THEN lan90 END, ping50) < 30 THEN '#fade2a' ELSE '#f2495c' END FROM c UNION ALL SELECT 'cat:' || category, category, format('%d services, CPE probe', services), CASE WHEN v IS NULL THEN '' ELSE format('%.1f ms', v) END, 'TCP connect p50', '#ff9830' FROM cat ) SELECT n.*, pos.x AS fixedx, pos.y AS fixedy FROM n JOIN pos ON pos.id = n.id

panels.title: Clients
panels.description: lan: the client's reply to the server's SYN-ACK, measured at the CPE (Wi-Fi or Ethernet round trip, and for clients of an extender also the backhaul and the extender). hop: the same reply measured at the extender the client is attached to, which is the extender-to-client hop alone, so lan - hop is what the backhaul and the extender add. ping: the CPE's ping, best of a burst. wan: the server's answer to the client's SYN. total: what the client waits for a connection, about lan + wan. rssi is the signal the access point receives from the client.

json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.proto') = 'tcp' AND status = 'ok') AS hop50, approx_percentile(CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.lan_ms') AS double), 0.9) FILTER (WHERE json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.proto') = 'tcp' AND status = 'ok') AS hop90 FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$ext' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'flow' GROUP BY 1 ), ew AS ( SELECT json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client') AS client, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.node'), ts_ms) AS node, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.band'), ts_ms) AS band, avg(CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.rssi') AS double)) AS rssi FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$ext' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'wifi_sta' GROUP BY 1 ), eu AS ( SELECT approx_percentile(rtt_ms, 0.5) AS v FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$ext' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'icmp' AND target_id = 'uplink' AND status = 'ok' ), p AS ( SELECT substr(target_id, 5) AS client, max_by(dst_ip, ts_ms) AS ip, max_by(coalesce(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.node'), 'cpe'), ts_ms) AS node, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.medium'), ts_ms) AS medium, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.band'), ts_ms) AS band, approx_percentile(rtt_ms, 0.5) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ok') AS ping50 FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'lan' GROUP BY 1 ), w AS ( SELECT json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client') AS client, avg(CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.rssi') AS double)) AS rssi, 100.0 * sum(CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.tx_retries') AS double)) / nullif(sum(CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.tx_sent') AS double)), 0) AS retry_pct FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'wifi_sta' GROUP BY 1 ), m AS ( SELECT json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.node') AS node, max_by(dst_ip, ts_ms) AS ip, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.node_mode'), ts_ms) AS mode, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.backhaul'), ts_ms) AS backhaul, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.parent'), ts_ms) AS parent FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'mesh_node' GROUP BY 1 ), c AS ( SELECT k.client, nm.label AS name, coalesce(fc.node, p.node, e.node, ew.node, 'cpe') AS node, coalesce(fc.medium, p.medium, e.medium) AS medium, coalesce(ew.band, fc.band, p.band, e.band) AS band, coalesce(fc.flows, 0) AS flows, coalesce(fc.lann, 0) AS lann, fc.lan50, fc.lan90, fc.wan50, p.ping50, coalesce(ew.rssi, w.rssi) AS rssi, w.retry_pct, coalesce(e.hopn, 0) AS hopn, e.hop50, e.hop90 FROM (SELECT client FROM fc UNION SELECT client FROM p UNION SELECT client FROM e) k LEFT JOIN fc ON fc.client = k.client LEFT JOIN p ON p.client = k.client LEFT JOIN w ON w.client = k.client LEFT JOIN e ON e.client = k.client LEFT JOIN ew ON ew.client = k.client LEFT JOIN nm ON nm.client = k.client WHERE k.client IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(p.ip, '') NOT IN (SELECT coalesce(ip, '') FROM m) ), x AS ( SELECT n.node, m.ip, m.backhaul FROM (SELECT node FROM m WHERE mode = 'AP' UNION SELECT node FROM c WHERE node <> 'cpe') n LEFT JOIN m ON m.node = n.node ) SELECT coalesce(name, client) AS client, client AS id, node, coalesce(band, medium) AS link, round(rssi) AS rssi, lan50 AS lan_p50, lan90 AS lan_p90, hop50 AS hop_p50, hop90 AS hop_p90, ping50 AS ping_p50, wan50 AS wan_p50, coalesce(lan50, ping50) + wan50 AS total_p50, retry_pct, flows FROM c ORDER BY flows DESC

panels.title: Home network incidents
panels.description: Incidents of the home network, from the CPE's probe and the extender's: one client (its LAN round trip, or on the extender its hop), several clients at once (home), or the extender's backhaul to the CPE. Open incidents have no end time; their duration runs to now. Only confirmed incidents (narrow ones that lasted 10 minutes) go to Slack. current and baseline are the worst member's latency now and normally.

targets.rawSQL: WITH nh AS ( SELECT coalesce(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client'), substr(target_id, 5)) AS client, max_by(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_name'), ts_ms) AS host FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device = '$device' AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind IN ('lan', 'flow') AND json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.client_name') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ), nm AS ( SELECT client, CASE WHEN count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY lower(host)) > 1 THEN host || ' #' || substr(client, 1, 4) ELSE host END AS label FROM nh WHERE NOT regexp_like(lower(host), '^(\*|localhost|unknown|none|wlan[0-9]*|eth[0-9]*|android[-_]?[0-9a-f]*|esp[-_][0-9a-f]+|espressif|[0-9a-f]{8,}|([0-9a-f]{2}[-:]?){6})$') ) , names AS (SELECT map_agg(client, label) AS mp FROM nm), e AS ( SELECT device, ts_ms, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.event') AS ev, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.incident_id') AS id, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.scope') AS scope, json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.cause') AS cause, CAST(json_extract(extra, '$.services') AS array(varchar)) AS services, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.duration_s') AS bigint) AS duration_s, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.confirmed') AS boolean) AS confirmed, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.targets[0].current_ms') AS double) AS cur, CAST(json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.targets[0].baseline_ms') AS double) AS base FROM heimdall.samples WHERE device IN ('$device', '$ext') AND dt BETWEEN $__rawTimeFrom('yyyy-MM-dd') AND $__rawTimeTo('yyyy-MM-dd') AND ts_ms BETWEEN ${__from} AND ${__to} AND kind = 'event' AND json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.event') LIKE 'incident\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND json_extract_scalar(extra, '$.scope') IN ('client', 'home', 'backhaul') ), i AS ( SELECT id, arbitrary(device) AS device, min(ts_ms) FILTER (WHERE ev = 'incident_start') AS start_ms, max(ts_ms) FILTER (WHERE ev = 'incident_end') AS end_ms, arbitrary(scope) AS scope, max_by(cause, ts_ms) AS cause, max_by(services, ts_ms) AS services, max(duration_s) AS duration_s, bool_or(coalesce(confirmed, true)) AS confirmed, max_by(cur, ts_ms) FILTER (WHERE cur IS NOT NULL) AS cur, max_by(base, ts_ms) FILTER (WHERE base IS NOT NULL) AS base FROM e GROUP BY id ) SELECT CAST(from_unixtime(start_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp) AS start_time, CAST(from_unixtime(end_ms / 1000.0) AS timestamp) AS end_time, coalesce(duration_s, CAST((to_unixtime(now()) * 1000 - start_ms) / 1000 AS bigint)) AS duration, CASE WHEN device = '$ext' THEN 'extender' ELSE 'cpe' END AS seen_by, scope, CASE cause WHEN 'roaming' THEN 'moved between access points' WHEN 'weak_signal' THEN 'weak Wi-Fi signal' WHEN 'retransmissions' THEN 'Wi-Fi retransmissions' WHEN 'radio_retransmissions' THEN 'busy or noisy radio' WHEN 'channel_busy' THEN 'busy Wi-Fi channel' WHEN 'extender' THEN 'behind the extender' WHEN 'weak_link_extender' THEN 'slow link to the extender' WHEN 'extender_wide' THEN 'extender, several clients' WHEN 'wired_lan' THEN 'wired LAN' WHEN 'lan_latency' THEN 'LAN path, no Wi-Fi sign' WHEN 'lan_wide' THEN 'whole home network' WHEN 'backhaul' THEN 'extender backhaul' ELSE cause END AS cause, array_join(transform(services, s -> coalesce(element_at(names.mp, s), s)), ', ') AS clients, cur AS current_ms, base AS baseline_ms, confirmed FROM i CROSS JOIN names WHERE start_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY start_ms DESC LIMIT 50
